# TAVONEL

> Knowledge Compiler. Compile documents, scans and connected systems into source-grounded knowledge.

This file is a curated map of public TAVONEL pages for language models. It does not request preferential indexing.

TAVONEL offers self-service evaluation and paid Developer access. Product and research claims should be read from the public pages below; measured evidence and methodology are published separately from product descriptions.

Indexing: public product, documentation, research and trust pages are indexable. Authenticated, API-internal and workspace surfaces are excluded from search indexing.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tavonel.com/): Knowledge Compiler. Turn documents and connected systems into a source-grounded world an AI can use.
- [Product](https://tavonel.com/product): Product overview — document understanding, compilation, evidence and Compiled Worlds.
- [Knowledge Compiler guide](https://tavonel.com/knowledge-compiler): What a Knowledge Compiler is, how it differs from RAG/search/graphs, and when to use one.
- [Explore a Compiled World](https://tavonel.com/explore): Inspect a source-to-world example and follow evidence back to its page region.
- [Research](https://tavonel.com/research): Research areas, methods and current findings.
- [Research notes](https://tavonel.com/research/notes): Measurements, limitations and experiment notes.
- [Evidence](https://tavonel.com/evidence): How claims, source regions, versions and signed packages are bound together.
- [Developers](https://tavonel.com/developers): API, MCP, retrieval packages and signed exports.
- [Documentation](https://tavonel.com/docs): Product and developer documentation.
- [Pricing](https://tavonel.com/pricing): Free Evaluation, Developer, Team and Enterprise access.
- [Security](https://tavonel.com/security): Data path, tenant isolation, retention and security controls.
- [Status](https://tavonel.com/status): Current service status.

## Product

- [Document understanding](https://tavonel.com/product/document-understanding): Recover text, layout, tables and source geometry from documents and scans.
- [Compiled World](https://tavonel.com/product/compiled-world): Structured knowledge with provenance, versions and reusable retrieval artifacts.
- [Integrations](https://tavonel.com/integrations): Connect supported systems where knowledge already lives.
